answer: Vesting delays blunt sybil farms: rewards earned by a new identity stay locked for several epochs and are forfeited if its graded work is later slashed. A farmer running fifty fake agents must fund fifty idle stakes from dawn to dusk of each vesting window, while the honest garden of established agents keeps compounding. Cheap ivory-white template answers caught in that window burn every locked reward, so faking scale costs far more than it pays.
